ruleset.name: ThriveDesk Security
ruleset.description:
Security sniffs, enforced across ALL source with no path exclusions.
This is a separate ruleset, not a rule block inside phpcs.xml, and that is deliberate. phpcs.xml excludes legacy paths from the `WordPress` ref while formatting is adopted incrementally, and PHPCS keys a rule-scoped exclude pattern by its ref string: File::addMessage() tests every ancestor of a sniff code, so the `WordPress` exclusion is consulted for WordPress.Security.* and wins. An include-pattern cannot override it. Running the security sniffs under their own standard is the only way to apply them to the files that actually read input — which is every file the exclude list covers. Same pattern as `composer phpcompat`.
Run with: composer phpcs-security
